main.description: Remove a role. Members holding it keep their other roles; the role is left off any access or permissions bindings that named it. Requires service-auth. Requires the `community.configure` action.

org.description: DID of the community the role belongs to.

role.description: Record key of the role to remove.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: No role with the given record key exists in this community.

errors.name: CannotDeleteBuiltinRole
errors.description: The admin and member roles are required by the community and cannot be deleted.
